title: The operad of multiple pre-Lie products indexed by a nonempty type set is the explicit rooted edge-typed tree operad
author: Loic Foissy
work: Algebraic Structures on Typed Decorated Rooted Trees
source_version: Official SIGMA 17 (2021) article 086, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2021.086; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs the typed substitution operad and identifies its generators and cross-type pre-Lie relations. Surjectivity uses a double induction on vertex number and root fertility, while injectivity is obtained from an independently constructed free multiple pre-Lie algebra. The supporting construction descends a Guin-Oudom action through an explicitly controlled kernel and verifies the universal tree-grafting map.

source_check.note: Read all Section3.1-3.3 supports: the typed grafting identity, scalar-type quotient construction of Theorem3.8, the rooted-forest action identity and free universal morphism of Corollary3.11, the two substitution associativity cases of Proposition3.14, and both surjectivity and injectivity in Theorem3.17. Standard untyped Guin-Oudom construction is explicitly cited prior background; the typed quotient kernel and free tree argument are fully supplied. Physical page12 was rendered and viewed because the PDF text layer encodes many formula glyphs poorly. Do not count the Koszul-dual computation or Hopf-algebra variants separately. Source approval supplied only by exact frozen root input; no new source/difficulty decision or mathematical referee.

retained_original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Theorem3.17 with a commutative field of characteristic zero and arbitrary nonempty edge-type set T. Multiple pre-Lie means the cross-type relation of Definition3.1, and the rooted-tree operadic substitution is exactly Proposition3.14. The generator of each type maps to the corresponding rooted two-vertex tree. No finiteness of T or Koszulness is added.
